propositions: Storage hypothesis to move unchanged macOS pytest temp trees to an APFS RAM disk was experimentally tested but rejected because all treated runs (18m43s, 20m54s, 18m26s, 20m00s default suite) were slower than the no-RAM control (17m26s), failing the predeclared retention threshold of at least 5% improvement.

The RAM-disk implementation exposed an intentional snapshot fixture defect where owner-nonwritable workflow directories caused PermissionError during recursive basetemp cleanup, requiring per-test teardown permission restoration.

A nested pytest cacheprovider leak in patchset 3 caused Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 collection failures until -p no:cacheprovider was added to the subprocess oracle, isolated and fixed without affecting test selection or assertions.

The merged fix removes the RAM-disk lifecycle, reporting, and detach steps, restoring both unchanged pytest tiers to runner.temp with distinct default and integration basetemps under runner.temp, keeping all selectors, markers, workers, timeouts, platforms, and coverage identical.
